scope: Bounded three-candidate audit of primary publications and official deposits for empirical validation of the version-2 exit-versus-growth-versus-marker ambiguity.
overall_decision: NO-GO for direct identification of post-withdrawal tolerant-to-sensitive exit hazard from the audited resources. CONDITIONAL GO for a narrower division/death benchmark using Oren Figure 1 source data after resolving its time/identity dictionary and reuse terms.
limits: No claim that a suitable dataset does not exist elsewhere. No author contact, raw-data republication, movie download, or large expression-matrix download. Four source workbooks totaling about 13.41 MB were inspected in memory; only metadata, hashes and field descriptions are retained.

candidates.title: Cycling cancer persister cells arise from lineages with distinct programs
candidates.model: EGFR-driven PC9 lung cancer cells; additional cell-line transcriptomic models are a separate resource.
candidates.observed_relevance: Paper reports 1135 live-imaged PC9 lineages, including 77 persister lineages, during continued osimertinib exposure. Division and death events were recorded. A single path was followed through divisions, with one sister selected; persister lineages also used endpoint-based retrospective tracing.

source_data.inspection: ZIP/XML workbook structure and headers, not a fitted reanalysis.
source_data.division_death_header_status: First rows/columns are numeric data, not named cell IDs, timestamps or event-code definitions. A column-time mapping and row identity dictionary were not verified.
source_data.other_sheets: Figure 1g contains population dose-response measurements of parental and persister-derived populations; Figure 1h contains population growth summaries. These are not continuous functional state labels on each tracked cell.

additional_small_workbook.contents: Figure ED1 a, A1:D8, a population dose-response table, not single-cell tracks.

repository.status: Public; official linked repository inspected through GitHub connector.
repository.data_inventory: Two Seurat RDS objects; transcriptomes with lineage barcodes, not microscopy event tables.
repository.license: GitHub repository metadata reports license:null; no explicit repository license verified.

candidates.movie_status: Live imaging is described, but no raw movie deposit was identified in the inspected article supplementary listing or linked Watermelon repository. The public numeric division/death workbook is more than a movie-only resource.
candidates.withdrawal_status: Population resensitization of persister-derived cells is reported, but no longitudinal post-withdrawal functional P-to-S label sequence linked to the division/death matrices was verified.
candidates.terms: Article publisher page specifies exclusive licence to Springer Nature Limited and no Creative Commons link was identified. Public source-file access is verified; an explicit open-data redistribution/training licence for this workbook was not verified. Link and summarize; do not mirror raw tables on that basis alone.
candidates.decision: CONDITIONAL GO for division/death observation-model development; NO-GO for the full withdrawal exit-hazard validation.
minimum_missing_fields: Exact mapping of matrix columns to elapsed time, including changes in acquisition intervals
Row-to-lineage and biological-replicate identifiers and event/censoring codebook
Parent/daughter links or an explicit analysis restricted to the sampled single path, including endpoint-based ascertainment
Withdrawal/rechallenge event timestamps attached to the same tracked lineages
Repeated functional tolerant/sensitive labels and independent marker-retention calibration
State re-entry events or a justified no-re-entry interval

candidates.title: IRS1 phosphorylation underlies the non-stochastic probability of cancer cells to persist during EGFR inhibition therapy
candidates.model: PC9 lung cancer gefitinib persistence, alongside other models.
candidates.verified_resources: Publisher lists three WMV supplementary time-lapse videos of PC9 under gefitinib for 80 days, source-data workbooks, and separate omics deposits GSE178978/GSE179240 and PRIDE accessions.

source_workbooks_inspected.observed_structure: Population drug-release, viability/growth inhibition and concentration summaries with experiment/replicate labels. These are not a complete linked per-cell withdrawal event history.

Clone/plate/timepoint and population object-count summaries, with generation/cycle comparisons. Header inspection did not identify a complete cell-parent-event table or repeated functional state labels. No numerical reanalysis performed.

Division, death, tracking-loss and end-of-observation event annotations

candidates.title: TrAEL-seq of osimertinib-treated PC9 cells in specific cell cycle stages
candidates.status: GSE335847 public 2026-06-22, last updated 2026-06-22; direct SOFT metadata retrieved. The GEO record has no linked publication citation at audit time.
candidates.model: PC9 cells at treatment days 7, 14 and 28, pretreatment controls and resistant derivatives; 13 sequencing samples, not 13 patients or imaging lineages.
candidates.relevance: Submitter summary reports continuing cycling and death balancing population size, directly relevant to why stable total abundance does not imply quiescence. This is a submitter's mechanistic description, not independent validation performed here.
candidates.actual_data_type: TrAEL-seq; SuperSeries includes RNA-seq GSE335846. Raw sequencing in SRA and a 13.8 MB processed genomic text file are listed. Only metadata were retrieved.
candidates.movie_and_track_status: No image movie, per-cell track table, division/death event log or functional state-transition annotation is listed in the inspected GEO records.
candidates.withdrawal_status: No withdrawal trajectory specified in the inspected series design.
candidates.terms: GEO describes its records/raw files as freely downloadable; these access terms do not establish a separate licence for any unlocated imaging data. No controlled-access application or file-specific licence is shown in the inspected public series metadata.
candidates.decision: NO-GO: assay mismatch. Suitable for a separate replication/cell-cycle question, not identification of switching versus growth/death from individual histories.
minimum_missing_fields: The underlying imaging resource or event-level division/death histories, if any
Cell/lineage identifiers and exact observation/censoring times
Functional state transitions and marker-retention measurements
A linked publication or complete imaging methods/data dictionary

focused_validation_design.status: Conceptual measurement specification for a qualified laboratory, not an operational wet-lab protocol or patient regimen.
focused_validation_design.question: After stress removal, does the observed change in a validated tolerant-state abundance require time-dependent exit after accounting separately for division, death, entry and marker change?
minimum_joint_observations: Persistent cell, parent, lineage, field and independent experimental-replicate identifiers
Both-daughter division and death events, with tracking loss distinguished from death and censored follow-up retained
Repeated functional-state observations or a prospectively validated reporter with independently measured marker retention
Functional resensitization assessment linked to the tracked lineage, with any destructive assay represented as such rather than a longitudinal observation
Absolute counts of both defined states and state-entry events
Time-specific assay variance, label error and missingness estimates
focused_validation_design.analysis_plan: Freeze the state definition and time window using an independent pilot. Compare constant exit, changing exit, changing division/death, marker-drift and re-entry models on held-out independent experimental replicates. Estimate state-specific transition hazards only from observed at-risk state durations and transition events; use divisions/deaths as separate events and preserve lineage dependence. Do not fit the hazard from a transcriptomic pseudotime or endpoint survivor label.
focused_validation_design.falsification: A curvature signal explained by measured growth/death or marker drift does not support changing exit. Failure of the changing-exit model to improve held-out joint event predictions rejects its claimed added explanatory value. Absence of a well-powered prespecified contrast constrains only the tested effect size and time window.
focused_validation_design.next_concrete_step: First resolve the Oren workbook's column-time mapping and sampled-lineage dictionary from source documentation; absent that information, retain it as a documented partial resource. Do not call the v2 synthetic contrast biologically validated.
